purpose: Connect only existing authoritative book-rule outputs to the Rule Adapter without copying or rebuilding book rules.

adapter_eligibility.rule: Only existing closed/frozen authoritative outputs may be normalized as authoritative evidence. Missing provenance must remain unavailable until exact source artifacts are resolved; no rule IDs or rule logic may be fabricated.

nison_mapping.activation_policy: Per-rule logic remains in existing source-locked outputs/source contracts. This mapping uses one canonical freeze commit pointer for the 44-rule governed scope and does not duplicate rule semantics.
nison_mapping.abstain_policy: Qualitative source language remains qualitative; unresolved cases must ABSTAIN; no numeric threshold is invented.
nison_mapping.oos_policy: 2025 locked OOS and not used for tuning.

hard_boundaries: No final BUY/SELL/entry/SL/TP/position size is generated by this mapping.
Trading in the Zone cannot create or reverse market direction.
Similarity remains historical evidence only and cannot override hard gates.
2025 remains OOS read-only and cannot be used for tuning or calibration.
Existing book evaluators and frozen source knowledge must not be rebuilt.
next_required_step: Run a 79-rule provenance completeness audit against the canonical Murphy and Nison commit pointers, then perform the first Rule Adapter integration test.
